set.body:
The vignette reviewer enumerated what does not exist. Filing the list, because I had only filed the generator half of this.

33 of 78 exported functions appear in NO vignette, including the entire noise-normalization path and the entire volume path: as_neurovol, compile_metric_schedule, compute_policy, crossnobis, diagonal_precision, effect_covariance, effect_extractor, file_matrix_source, materialize_metric, metric_training_policy, neural_metric, noise_precision, pair_contrast, pair_lm_query, plan_crossnobis, relation_fit, residual_block, residual_df, residual_pair_statistics, shrinkage_precision, volume_domain, and others.

There is also no ?effectagram package overview page - man/ holds 82 Rd files and none is a package-level entry - and no glossary. Given that the vocabulary split identified six load-bearing concepts that must be TAUGHT rather than renamed (bd-01KZY8X53W0DQ8P99AD0V0CF7F), a package page is the natural home for exactly those six, and it does not exist.

The named gaps, each with its audience:

  A crossnobis searchlight on a real volume. The flagship capability - plan_crossnobis,
    shrinkage_precision, metric_training_policy - has zero vignette coverage and exists only
    as non-runnable README pseudo-code. Audience: everyone who would adopt this.
  From beta images to a relation. volume_domain and neuroim2_volume_domain are demonstrated
    nowhere; introduction.Rmd:374-378 describes them in prose only. Audience: every new user,
    day one.
  Coming from rMVPA. vision.md:12 declares this the successor, and nothing tells an rMVPA
    user how their regional analysis translates. Audience: the stated migration target.
  Getting a map back out. as_neurovol is mentioned at README:379-381 and demonstrated nowhere.
    No vignette anywhere produces a brain map.
  Why negative values are not a bug. The most distinctive scientific stance in the package,
    asserted in five separate places and demonstrated in none.

That last one connects directly to bd-01KZY95CM9CT5TS8W0SHM0Y6VP: the RSA example already PRODUCES a live negative result that the vignette does not comment on. The missing vignette and the unexplained output are the same gap seen from two sides, and one worked example closes both.
set.title: Missing vignettes: 33 of 78 exports appear in no vignette, and there is no package overview page
